# MATCH joins the incoming working table by shared variables, or forms a cross product.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
# FinGraph has Knows edges 10:1->2, 11:2->1, 12:1->1, 13:1->2, and Owns 1->7.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) MATCH (b:Person)-[:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "9"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (A:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 999) MATCH (b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) WHERE a.id = 2 MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) MATCH (b:Person)-[:Owns]->(c:Account) RETURN c.kind AS result)
=> "checking"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (b:Person) WHERE b.id = a.id RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) MATCH (c:Person)-[e:Knows]->(d:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "4"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 MATCH (b:Person)-[:Knows]->(c:Person), (c:Person)-[:Owns]->(d:Account) RETURN d.id AS result)
=> "7"

# Pass graph paths and scalar projections between stages without duplicating or losing rows.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 MATCH q = (b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN PATH_LENGTH(p) + PATH_LENGTH(q) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) RETURN a.id AS id NEXT MATCH (b:Person) WHERE b.id = id RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"

# Identity includes private keys, composite keys and the element table.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) MATCH (b:Person)-[f:Knows]->(c:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH (a:Compound)-[e:CompoundEdge]->(b:Compound) MATCH (b:Compound)-[f:CompoundEdge]->(c:Compound) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (a:Author) MATCH (a:Reader) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"

# The resolver's implicit equality does not enable explicit graph comparisons.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (b:Person) WHERE a = b RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support
